name: all-clear-reset
intent: ALL CLEAR retracts threat ALERT geometry, stamps ALL CLEAR, then quietly rebuilds the operations panel.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Operations panel appears immediately; no retract, stamp, or rebuild animation

acceptance: Alert: ALERT overlay covers host; operations panel hidden
ALL CLEAR retracts alert geometry to centre point over 420ms
ALL CLEAR stamp slams at 360ms delay over 280ms then fades before rebuild
Operations panel rebuilds quietly (500ms, 120ms delay) without alert visible
Done: nominal ops copy visible; RESET shown
RESET restores ALERT overlay and idle live copy
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows ops panel immediately
No network; effect stays inside host panel
waveB: Frozen retract/stamp/rebuild timings; dedicated ALL CLEAR stamp phase before quiet panel rebuild
